name: Tic Tac Toe Smoke Test
description: A compact tic-tac-toe benchmark where the agent plays X against a seeded novice O opponent.

binding_vow.description: Play tic-tac-toe as X. On each turn, choose one empty board cell index from 0 to 8. The environment plays O after each valid X move. Win by making three X marks in a row, column, or diagonal.

observation_space.description: { "board": list[string], "board_rows": list[list[string]], "cell_indices": list[list[int]], "valid_actions": list[int], "moves_remaining": int, "message": string }

action_space.description: Return one empty cell index from 0 to 8. A bare number like 4 is preferred, but text containing a single valid index is accepted.

reward.description: 1.0 if X wins; 0.0 for a draw, loss, or invalid move.
